svg.title: Structure of the notebook04_dag_gating_summary.csv artifact
svg.desc: Visualization of the gating summary CSV file written by NB04 with three columns named feature dag_prefix and allowed_for_risk, showing ten sample rows that demonstrate the structure: rows with allowed prefixes VOL MACRO and REGIME have True in the boolean column shown in teal text, and rows with forbidden prefixes MOM VAL ML and SENT have False shown in red text, with a summary at the bottom indicating 151 total rows of which exactly 74 have allowed_for_risk equal to True.
svg.text: Test 5 — counts a boolean column in a committed CSV artifact
151 rows total — same as the non-sentiment working matrix
Test 5 sums the True values in the boolean column and asserts the total is exactly 74.
This is the frozen empirical constant from the M6 capstone — the snapshot of project state being protected.
If NB04 is ever re-run with different feature engineering and the count drifts to 73 or 75, this test fails.
That drift demands an explicit acknowledgment — either fix the upstream change, or update the constant.
